name: extrude-pop
title: Extrude Pop
description: A flat word pops up out of the plane on a solid colored 3D body, no camera involved.
useWhen: A short punchy word (a score, a verdict, a CTA) should land with physical weight, like a stamp rising off the page.
A faux-3D pop with no cameras or 3D transforms: a 2D extrusion that renders identically everywhere.
avoidWhen: The text is long or small: the extruded body doubles the ink, so keep it to one short word.
You need real perspective or a moving camera: the extrusion angle is fixed.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Face color
variables.description: Color of the word's front face.

variables.label: Extrusion radius
variables.description: Half the final depth of the extrusion, in px at 1920×1080.

variables.label: Extrusion angle
variables.description: Direction the body extends, in degrees.

variables.label: Extrude frames
variables.description: Frame at which the extrusion is fully grown (30 fps).
